purpose: Instrumented bench mechanism checks; no measured results supplied. These project acceptance thresholds are not engineering standards.
partition_rule: Whole events are assigned before collection. Calibration events end before model freeze; validation events begin afterwards. No fitting, threshold change, sample exclusion or partition relabelling using validation outcomes.

event_plan.interpretation: For each mechanism, 01/02 are independently reset current/restored runs, 03/04 repeat those two states with a separate reset. Freeze exact forcing, geometry, state, pairing and analysis windows in a witnessed lab run sheet before data collection. This template does not establish that witness or collection happened.

uncertainty_rule: Instrument expanded absolute uncertainty at coverage factor 2, conservative linear bounds, plus timestamp uncertainty and declared unmeasured-loss bound. Pass requires error upper bound within threshold; fail requires lower bound above threshold; overlap is unresolved.
integration_rule: Trapezoidal integration at actual adjacent timestamp intervals only, with no missing values, no interval above maximum_sample_gap_s, and no extrapolation. Receiving-boundary outflow is signed positive outward, negative for backflow.
limitations: No measured experiment has been completed by freezing this protocol.
Bench scale is not a similarity proof for township hydraulics.
The checks do not establish work-site safety or operational permission.
Source and calibration authenticity require independent human review.
Threshold or instrumentation changes require a new protocol version before new validation events; previous failures remain in the record.
